channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: The Great Beauty Event
channel.desc: Join us for a day dedicated to helping you look beautiful! Featuring specially selected products all available on four Easy Pay instalments, spread the cost of pampering yourself from top to toe.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: skinSense by Abi Cleeve
channel.desc: Bringing together the latest, ground-breaking technology with the highest grade concentration of unique active ingredients, discover long-lasting skincare with anti-ageing benefits from skinSense.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Steals and Deals
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see the latest deals and bag a beauty bargain. We've got an exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Meet the Beauty Experts
channel.desc: This show features a wide range of beauty products for your body, face, hair and nails, plus a selection of make-up. Plus our top beauty experts will be on hand to give you great advice and tips.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: In the Salon with Gatineau
channel.desc: Professional beauty products from the pioneering skincare specialists. Gatineau combines the highest quality plant and marine extracts with the very latest cutting-edge biotechnology.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Love Beauty with Clinique
channel.desc: Join us to explore the much-loved beauty icon that is the Clinique range. Offering easy-to-use formulas for all skin types, this incredible beauty range will have you head over heels in no time.
